notes.title: Voice of Flowers on Polish Constitution Days 2025
notes.content:
Updated Voice of Flowers Demo is featured in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/PolishConstitutionDays2025]Polish Constitution Days 2025[/url]. The event lasts from 24 April to 3 May.

The new demo features improved visuals, new sound effects and various fixes and improvements. It also includes some new features, like Music Room and quest markers. See below for full changelog.

The new update also brings improvements to the game's translation. All previously untranslated texts that were part of the demo are now translated. Only Polish translation was updated, and it's no longer marked as experimental (Voice of Flowers team is based in Poland, in case you didn't know).

As for the next demo, the Final Demo, content-wise it's already complete. We'll soon be working on polishing it, so it's ready to be released. No ETA as of now, but we might release it early via a public beta version (more details on Discord). The Final Demo is also fully translated to Polish. Other languages will be available closer to the game's release.

Changelog for the demo update:

v.0.2.6
- New sprite for relic block.
- New icons for various items.
- New sprite for the Heater.
- Added Music Room in Extras (available after finishing demo).
- Various new sound effects.
- Improved Ghost Town visuals.
- Collected blue coins will now stay collected when leaving room.
- Added quest markers to game menu map.
- Fangfliers will stop following you after they deal damage.
- Rusty Dagger will behave differently when hitting wall and enemy.
- Changed default font.
- Changed in-game audio option icons to white.
- Some music was replaced.
- Updated translations.
- Suspending the game no longer cures poison etc.
- Fixed bestiary not properly displaying unlocked entries.
- Fixed typo in Penguin Pajamas name (missing s).
- Fixed in-game options highlight offset.
- Fixed bug when using Hydro-Mortar in air.
- Fixed wrong ordering of some graves near Ghost Town.
- Fixed save info shifting based on content.

As always, please report any bugs or feedback, either at the Steam Community forum or on the Discord server. Also be sure to drop by the Discord for more frequent updates.

[url=https://discord.gg/PGhFXeHApR][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2609560/extras/VoF_Discord01.png[/img][/url]

~KoBeWi

notes.title: Demo update 1 hotfix
notes.content:
The previous update introduced a startup crash that prevented the game from running. Sorry about that!
This update fixes it, plus replaces some more placeholder graphics, as we continue to finish up the Haunted Tundra content.

Full changelog:
v.0.2.5
- Added lore to Relics tab.
- The game directory now includes a console-mode executable that allows easier troubleshooting of bugs.
- New relic icons.
- Fixed startup crash.

notes.title: Demo Update 1
notes.content:
Voice of Flowers Demo gets a new update including new content and changes based on your feedback.
Thanks to everyone who played it and reported any bugs.

Here is the list of changes:
v.0.2.4
- Added Snow Tank enemy (it was previously not included due to lacking sprite).
- Added achievement for Speedrun Mode.
- Added missing NPC sprites.
- Added missing enemy sprites.
- Snow Tank now counts for "Demon Hunter" achievement instead of CommonBot. 
- Normalized sound volume when breaking multiple bricks at once.
- Fixed Speedrun Mode label glitch after restarting from game over.

Earlier updates:
v.0.2.3
- Changed Always Run behavior - Run button will now walk when this option is enabled.
- Fixed a bug where dialogues would show only once.
- Fixed crash when trying to change help page without help entry visible.
- Fixed a crash when using Sell in the shop after scrolling to the bottom of Buy.
- Fixed Sound and Shake Strength sliders not working properly in some cases.

v.0.2.2
- Fixed black screen when changing maps from Frosttown
- Fixed not being able to enter houses
- Fixed double music when restarting from Frosttown

notes.title: New demo - Haunted Tundra is out!
notes.content:
The Haunted Tundra demo brings a completely new, winter-themed region for you to explore, featuring new enemies, bosses, items and secrets. Meet the residents of Frosttown, break the curse of Haunted Forest, fight ghosts in the Haunted Manor. 

New game mechanics are introduced, including quests, relics, teleports and sub-weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728534/badcd2deb63fc1c39f864e5ccbf3157825bb3a5a.gif[/img]

[h2]Whats new?[/h2]
Have you played previous, desert-themed demo and want to know what changed?
Haunted Tundra demo:
[list]
[*] Happens later in the story.
[*] Introduces open-ended exploration.
[*] Adds 2 new bosses for you to find and defeat.
[*] Exposes some bits of story via dialogues with NPCs.
[*] Adds numerous new equipment and spells.
[*] Adds 14 new achievements to help you track your progress.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728534/2f3ff2d87b045013db4c15e2bb9b0b8792a6940b.png[/img]
Do note that the demo is not fully finished on the art side. There are still some placeholder sprites, especially for new items. We'll update the demo once they are finalized ;)

In the meantime, feel free to submit any feedback and bug reports.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728534/18611b0622070b3576d016b9dc8372fd2c8c6b7d.png[/img]
From other news, the demo also includes experimental translations for Polish, German and Japanese. They are very incomplete and mostly machine translated, and the language list is subject to change. Nonetheless, you can play the game in other languages.

[h2]Coming up next: Final Demo[/h2]

The next milestone for Voice of Flowers is to finish the "Final Demo". 

The Final Demo will feature the initial areas of the game, starting from the Desert known from the first demo, and ending in Frosttown, the starting area of Haunted Tundra demo.

The Final Demo should provide the full experience of the game's beginning sequence areas and a proper introduction to the game's story, and could be completed in 2 to 4 hours, depending on your play style.

[h2]Discord[/h2]

Join the official Discord for more updates on the game progress and to chat with the developers.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FPGhFXeHApR][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728534/4c39ad68a62748f1d96d594f02c7c486a497cdbb.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Near future plans
notes.content:
Hello dear players!

As you might remember (or not) from an earlier announcement, the demo was not supposed to land on Steam until more content was finished. But as the game was featured in Steam events, it only made sense to let people play it. The events overall were a success. A small one, but it helped Voice of Flowers get noticed by many more players.

Now with both Baltic Showcase and Metroidvania Fusion events finished, the demo will again be pulled out from Steam until [i]final demo[/i] is ready, or until another Steam event. In the meantime you will still be able to play the game on itch.io.

[h3]The next demo[/h3]
The next demo version is dubbed Haunted Tundra Demo. It will take place in a remote snowy region and feature much more locations to explore, 2 bosses and new magic spells. Here's a little sneak peak of a new area (WIP):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728534/ad42983ce91a5c2dc7b4fb27d30465968e73f923.png[/img]
Note that the demo has no precise ETA as of now. If it happens that the game will get featured in another Steam event before the new demo is finished, the desert demo will be pulled once again.

[h3]Final demo[/h3]
The "final demo" is the next planned demo version after Haunted Tundra and it will be the last one content-wise. It's still far off, but the plan is to have it available permanently before and after the game release (with occasional feature updates).

The final demo will feature 4 "biomes" and the beginning of the story the way it's intended to play. The content is mostly finished, but it needs lots of polishing. It's the famous last 5% that takes 95% of the time ;)

[h3]What's next?[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728534/9f4fd63ebedaddcf59f9c0f3b7197bd801511576.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728534/aa517371f0f17d389563731b529bc713e8fb1d97.png[/img][/url]

Further plans will be announced once the "final demo" is finished. For now the itch.io version is going to be updated with the new Steam content (including achievements!), so people that missed it can still play it. And the current small demo has surprisingly many secrets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728534/dd76a35fc35049476d99eeb786a259dce2fbddf6.png[/img][i]Fanart by Kago[/i]

If you want to keep closer in touch with the development, chat with the developers or other players, or just can't wait for more content and want to wait faster, join the official Discord server.

[url=https://discord.gg/PGhFXeHApR][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2609560/extras/VoF_Discord01.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Demo update, v.0.1.5
notes.content:
Demo has been updated again. Game customization options were planned as a later feature, but seeing how some people already tried speedruning the demo, I decided to implement it earlier.

List of changes:
- Added game customization options.
- Speedrun Mode: Displays a persistent timer that counts active game time and skips dialogues.
- Disable Minimap: Disables in-game minimap.
- Disable Help Prompts: Disables help tooltips and notifications.
- Disable Quest Prompts: Unused in demo :P
- Removed some too obvious debug option.
- Reworked how time is counted internally to make it more accurate. As a side-effect, time is also counted while in game menu.
- Fixed one spot where the character can get awkwardly stuck.

Remember there's [url=https://discord.gg/PGhFXeHApR]an official Discord sever[/url], where you can discuss the game, give feedback and share your speedrun times. The current best time is 3:19 😅

notes.title: Voice of Flowers is part of Metroidvania Fusion event
notes.content:
Metroidvania Fusion is a new Steam event that features over 170 metroidvania games, from new indie treasures to iconic franchises. Voice of Flowers is lucky to be featured alongside them :D

The event page can be found here:
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/41046058/sale/MetroidvaniaFusion


[h3]Demo[/h3]
As the event streak continues, the demo will be available for one more week and [i]might[/i] receive another update in the meantime. This also depends on your feedback. While the demo shows only a very small portion of the game, player feedback is always valuable and shapes the final product. Remember that you can join the [url=https://discord.gg/PGhFXeHApR]official Discord server[/url] or use the Steam Community Discussions to share your thoughts.

Once the event is over, I'll share more info about the next demo and the general plans for the near future of Voice of Flowers. In the meantime, someone on Discord started speedruning the demo and announced a challenge to beat their time 👀

notes.title: Demo update, v.0.1.4
notes.content:

List of changes:
- Starting the game will now create a save file immediately.
- Some Controls options are now hidden.
- Improved some enemy collision shapes.
- Tweaked physics to make it easier to fit into passages when falling.
- Made Batflier swoop slightly slower.
- Tweaked Cacrawl hole traps.
- Tweaked placement of some enemies.
- Updated icon for Crab Shell (it will be revised again in the future).
- Updated Rose Charger bestiary preview.
- Bestiary can be now scrolled by pages, using left and right keys.
- Improved "DEMO" in title screen.
- Fixed map optimization bug.
- Fixed abrupt animation when exiting save point.
- Fixed physics stability in case of lower FPS values.
- Fixed starter equipment having NEW indicator.
- Fixed some Controls options displaying incorrectly when edited.
- Fixed some tiles not having collision.

If you want to give feedback about the demo or report bugs, you can join the official Discord sever: https://discord.gg/PGhFXeHApR
